text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you nervous, Rice-san?
Your face looks all stiff. Are you alright?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I was just so determined
to catch up to Bourbon-san today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Still... seeing Bourbon-san made me freeze up. ...Can I really win?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You can win!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"You can win! I mean, she worked so hard
that her shoes were worn to tatters!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "Even if you don't win, today's race will surely serve as great nourishment for your next victory."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, I always think something like that before a race. Heehee.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So really, it's totally okay!
You're doing just fine, Rice!

As if infected by Matikanetannhauser's smile,
Rice Shower's expression gradually began to
soften once again.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Tannhauser-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Thank you...!
Rice will do her best...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, wait, I'm so sorry...!
Tannhauser-san is running too,
and here I am only talking about Bourbon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way, that's completely natural!
I mean, it's Bourbon-san we're talking about~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I mean, speak of the devil and she appears!
Let's keep this momentum going and declare war right now!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A declaration of... war...!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's power in the spoken word!
Come on, off you go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...?
Tannhauser, why are you hiding over there...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, um, Bourbon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you for having me today!
Rice will... catch up to you, Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Rice-san.
Mihono Bourbon firmly grasped Rice Shower's trembling right hand in return.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Likewise.
I have no intention of losing to you either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, mhm!
Rice did her best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, for someone who has watched over her since the Satsuki Sho, it's an indescribably moving sight!

"I'd forgotten, but back in the Satsuki Sho,
she hid at the edge of the underground tunnel
as if making way for Mihono Bourbon to psych herself up."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well, y'know,
I just thought I'd be in the way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Take the climax of a movie, for example,
when rivals share an impassioned handshake—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's not like regular folks are gonna mix in during that time, right?
She's a precious Umamusume with genuine talent.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "No, no, come on now. People are gonna start calling you a doting trainer instead of a doting parent."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, that doesn't matter right now!
More importantly, look—

Matikanetannhauser casually began
groping at thin air with her right hand.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Around here, maybe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's an air handshake!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
What's with that look in your eyes?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, if I want to live up to the Chairwoman's expectations, firing myself up is important!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"I am just an ordinary Umamusume,
though Chairwoman has high hopes as well—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, well, it's a bit late to bring this up, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why are you putting your hopes in me
instead of Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If it's about guiding someone or something like that,
wouldn't Bourbon-san be better?
Even Rice gets guided by her.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Well, whatever!
Focus on the race for now!

With various things on everyone's minds...
the Nippon Derby got underway!
